## Fixes

- **Missing pixels in the map on Linux.** When the map pane was an odd number of pixels wide or tall, its centre fell on half a pixel. At 100% each screen pixel then sampled exactly on the edge between two tile pixels. Linux graphics drivers round that edge differently, so some rows and columns of tile pixels were drawn twice and their neighbours dropped. Thin details like rods, railings and the arms of pillar caps went missing, although the game draws them. The map, its overlays and the mouse now all centre on a whole pixel, so every tile pixel is drawn once.
